name: Parties
description: Who is in a deal. Buyer, target, and each advisor are instances of one organization. They share this vocabulary. They are not separate domains, and a second advisor is a fourth instance, not a new kind.

entities.name: Organization
entities.description: A firm. Harbor buys, Northline is acquired, Vale advises on the financials, Ledger & Kline is the buyer's counsel. One entity, four instances.

entities.name: Person
entities.description: A person who acts for one of the firms.

entities.name: Team
entities.description: A group inside an organization. The clean team is an instance, not a kind of its own.

attributes.name: organization
attributes.description: The firm this team belongs to.

entities.name: Membership
entities.description: A membership is an entity because the connection between a person and an organization carries a role, and may name a team. A relationship has no attributes of its own to hold the role.

attributes.name: team
attributes.description: The team, when the membership is to one. Absent for a firm-wide membership.

instances.name: Renee on the clean team
instances.description: The same person, on the target's clean team.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The membership is of a person.

relationships.name: in
relationships.description: The membership is in an organization.

relationships.name: on
relationships.description: The membership is on a team, when it names one.

relationships.name: within
relationships.description: A team sits within an organization.
